abstract: Teratocarcinoma cells (OTT 6050) from 129 SvSl C P mice were transferred into blastocysts from random bred Swiss albino mice. The blastocysts were placed in the uteri of foster mothers and the adults resulting from these blastocysts were studied for evidence of an effect of the transferred malignant cells. Sixty adults resulted from the experiments, and one of the adult mice that had received teratocarcinoma cells in the blastocyst stage showed several stripes of agouti hair. All the adult animals received grafts of skin from animals identical to those supplying the cells. The animals that resulted from blastocysts into which cells had been transferred maintained skin grafts for a significantly longer period than did controls. These experiments indicate that the transferred malignant cells were able to establish small colonies in the embryos and that some of these cells persisted into the adult.
abstract_ja: 本研究では、129 SvSl C P系マウス由来の奇形癌細胞（OTT 6050）を、ランダム繁殖のSwissアルビノマウスの胚盤胞に移植した。その胚盤胞を仮親の子宮に移植し、得られた成体について、移植された悪性細胞の影響の有無を検討した。実験から60匹の成体が得られ、胚盤胞期に細胞を移植された成体の1匹に、アグーチ様の被毛の縞模様が数本見られた。すべての成体には、細胞の供給元と同一系統の動物から皮膚移植を行った。胚盤胞由来の個体は、対照群と比べて皮膚移植片を有意に長く維持した。これらの実験は、移植された悪性細胞が胚内で小さなコロニーを形成し、その一部が成体になっても残存したことを示している。
